newsitem.title: FRANCE: Usinor hopes dollar will help 97 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Usinor hopes dollar will help 97 earnings.

text.p: Usinor Sacilor said on Tuesday that the dollar may help 1997 results if the U.S. currency remains at strong current levels.
"For the second half of the year, if the dollar remains at current levels, earnings could be more ambitious than what we were expecting previously," Chairman Francis Mer told a news conference.

He was answering to a query about a forecast made by the company in September that 1997 earnings would be significantly higher than in 1996. Mer said earlier at the conference that he hoped the steelmaker would improve its earnings in 1997.
Usinor reported that 1996 profits fell to 1.49 billion francs in 1996 from a record 4.43 billion francs in 1995.
